“Aynabaazi” to be released on the eve of Independence Day
2016-02-27T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/showbiz/deshi-grapevine/%E2%80%9Caynabaazi%E2%80%9D-be-released-the-eve-independence-day-782806

Filming of Chanchal Chowdhury and debutant Masuma Rahman Nabila starrer "Aynabaazi"was completed last August. The movie is slated to be released on March 25. Directed by Amitabh Reza, it is a psychological thriller centered on the life of a prodigious actor. Partha Barua is also expected to appear in a lead role in the movie. Lutfur Rahman George, Hira Chowdhury, Shawkat Osman and Gausul Alam Shawon also have roles in the production.

Established actor Chanchal Chowdhury has appeared in five movies till date. Another movie, "Valobashi Tare", is under production which will see him as the lead next year. First song of "Aynabaazi","Alu-Piyaz-Er Kabbo", composed and performed by Arnob has been released and the popular band Chirkutt has performed in the title track.
